theory.name: Langarian Finite Complex Transformations
theory.summary: The executable finite-complex-vector package currently powering the workbench.
theory.motivation: Make mathematical transformations reproducible, receipt-bearing, and unable to overstate what one computation establishes.

objects.name: ResonantState
objects.definition: A finite vector in C^n, 1 <= n <= 64, plus bounded metadata and receipt history.

objects.name: OperationReceipt
objects.definition: A versioned integrity record for one operator execution and its checks.

objects.name: BridgeResult
objects.definition: A recorded source/target relation candidate with similarity and edge-local declared cost.

operators.name: harmonic_sum
operators.semantics: Zero-pad to a common dimension and add componentwise.

operators.name: attenuated_phase_shift
operators.semantics: A_(theta,eta)(x) = eta exp(i theta) x for eta >= 0.

operators.name: bridge
operators.semantics: Record a source/target relation candidate, normalized similarity, and an edge-local caller declaration.

assumptions.text: The executable model is finite-dimensional and represented with finite IEEE-754 components.
Zero-padding is the selected embedding convention for unequal dimensions.

invariants.text: phase_shift preserves Euclidean norm in exact arithmetic.
Every operation receipt records declared input hashes and an output hash.

allowed: listed checks ran under declared versions
two implementation surfaces conform to reviewed fixtures
prohibited: a demonstration fixture is mathematically privileged
zero bridge edge cost means zero historical path cost

evidence.notes: The package is a mathematical software workbench, not an empirically validated physical theory.
